Two 2 Terpercaya Advisory Committee meetings were supported the first on 10 March 2021 focusing on the transition of the Terpercaya Initiative to become a part of KAMI and on the Advisory Committees role moving forward within KAMI and the second on 25 November 2021 focusing on the latest KAMI activities the Advisory Committee Terms of Reference and roadmap and options for supply chain traceability and jurisdictional sourcing under KAMI. During the 23rd ASEANEU Ministerial Meeting AEMM on 1 December 2020 a joint working group between the EU and relevant ASEAN Member States was launched to address the challenge towards reaching Sustainable Development Goals in the vegetable oil sector. The Joint Working Group on Palm Oil between the European Union and relevant ASEAN member countries met for the first time online on 27 January 2021. In preparation for the meeting KAMI drafted a background paper on palm oilrelated policy developments in Indonesia Malaysia and the EU. The paper was provided to representatives of the EU and the Governments of Malaysia and Indonesia with the expectation that it would be shared with the full working group as KAMI does not have a mandate to communicate directly with the working group. In preparation for a second Working Group meeting KAMI prepared an additional four technical background papers on i national palm oil sustainability standards ii palm oil smallholder challenges iii palm oil and deforestation and iv the Job Creation Law and palm oil in Indonesia with the expectation that these would be used to inform discussions during the working group meeting although due to political sensitivity iii was only shared with EU members of the KAMI Indonesia and Malaysia SCBs while others were shares with all SCB members. An additional paper on EU policy and regulation related to palm oil was prepared but only shared with EU members of the KAMI Indonesia and Malaysia SCBs without further circulation as directed by DG ENV. In 2022 in response to a request for information for the second Joint Working Group Meeting on Palm Oil between the European Union and Relevant ASEAN Member States on 28 June 2022 KAMI provided background information on KAMI key messages and defensives.

Building on the dialogue initiated in 2018 through the pilot approach Terpercaya in Indonesia a collective approach on palm oil sustainability has been developed and adopted. The Terpercaya database and data platform developed with support from EU and EFI including through KAMI were transferred from EU to the Indonesian Development Planning Agency Bappenas and adopted by Government of Indonesia on 11 November 2021. In 2022 KAMI supported the public launch of one Sustainable Jurisdictions Indicators SJI formerly Terpercaya data platform at the B20 Investment Forum in Bali. Continuing support to this collective approach to include information on legal and deforestation free palm oil production and further develop the legal basis and data sharing mechanisms will further align the approach with the EUDR. In 2023 further development of the SJI data platform was supported by KAMI including technical assistance to refine the indicators collect indicator data raise awareness of the SJI initiative more broadly and build capacity in districts through eight SJI outreach workshops in key palm oilproducing regions. Support was also provided to develop draft Bappenas Sustainable Jurisdictions Indicators SJI regulations.
